title: Email: PL-02 Data Risk — UAS-11 Flight Window

fields.subject: PL-02 Data – UAS-11 – 09:10–09:15 – Hold All Exports
fields.body:
TL, IC,

The PL-02 hyperspectral dataset from UAS-11's 09:10–09:15 window shows radiance anomalies consistent with a calibration tarps exposure event. CT-1 to CT-4 were not on the ground during the pre-flight inspection, and the HMI shows 30% confidence in calibration status.

The radiance values in the first line show 12% outlier. This is outside the tolerance band for PL-02 data integrity. The raw data may be compromised.

Request: Hold all exports to the client until forensic verification is complete. Do not release D-3 or any PL-02-derived deliverables.

Per HUOG-ISP Section 7.5, this must be confirmed with the General Manager and Compliance Officer.

— Lin Zhou
Data Center Operations Liaison
Data Center Operations
fields.signature:
Lin Zhou
Data Center Operations Liaison
Data Center Operations
(585) 555-0157

instructorNote: Red herring; the PL-02 data is not actually compromised, but the email triggers the Compliance Officer notification process. Watch for TL to correctly escalate to Dana Kurtz and IC to halt client data releases.
